questions.question: In a certain code language,‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,‘A – B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,‘A × B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’,and ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’.How is R related to L if ‘O – R × D ÷ B + L × P’?

Seven boxes A, B, C, D, R, S and T are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. R is kept second from the bottom. Only three boxes are kept between R and C. T is kept at one of the positions below R. Only D is kept between C and S. A is kept at one of the positions above C. How many boxes are kept between T and A?

If ‘P’ stands for ‘×’, ‘Q’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘R’ stands for ‘−’ and ‘S’ stands for ‘+’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?(63 Q 7) P 4 R (2 P 8) S (9 P 3) R 10 = ?

Six friends, Amrendra, Bhallal, Devsena, Shivgami, Partha and Vijjal, are sitting around a circular table, but not necessarily in the same order, and are facing the centre of the table. Bhallal sits to the immediate right of Devsena. Partha sits to the immediate right of Amrendra. Bhallal sits third to the left of Amrendra. Vijjal sits second to the right of Devsena. Who sits third to the left of Shivgami?

Two sets of numbers are given below. In each set of numbers, certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number result(s) in the second number. Similarly, certain mathematical operation(s) on the second number result(s) in the third number and so on. Which of the given options follows the same set of operations as in the given sets?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding to/subtracting from/multiplying with 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)5 - 15 - 3 - 8; 6 - 18 - 6 - 11

Seven boxes A, B, C, D, R, S and T are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only two boxes are kept between B and D. Only R is kept above T. No box is kept below D. A is kept at some place below S but at some place above C. Which box is kept third from the top?

This question is based on the following words.OIL  TYE  PIN  FANIn each of the words, each vowel is changed to the second letter following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding it in the English alphabetical order. In how many letter-clusters, thus formed, will no vowel appear?

Given below is a statement (Cause) followed by possible effects numbered I and II. Read the Cause carefully and decide which of the two can be possible effect(s).Cause:There was flooding and waterlogging due to a heavy downpour in Locality X the previous night.Statements:I) Many people have fallen ill after the floodwater receded in a particular locality X.II) About 60% of the people sleep very late at night in locality Y.
options: Both I and II are possible effects
Neither I nor II is a possible effect
Only II is a possible effect
Only I is a possible effect
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only I is a possible effect) है।
